text: The new prerelease Microsoft.Agents.AI.DurableTask plugs Agent Framework workflows into the Durable Task stack. Each Executor<TInput,TOutput> step gets checkpointed, so a multi-step agent run can crash, redeploy, or scale across processes and resume where it stopped. Combine with Microsoft.Agents.AI.Hosting.AzureFunctions and exposeMcpToolTrigger:true to expose the workflow as an MCP tool callable by Claude or Copilot agents.
